description: Sets product prices in price lists (POST /b2b/v1/prices/set), at most 100 per request. Prices are decimal STRINGS (e.g. "150.00"); price_per_quantity (pack size the price applies to) defaults to 1 when omitted. The response body is not documented upstream (2xx = success) and is returned verbatim. There is no delete endpoint for prices.

price.description: New price as a decimal string, e.g. "150.00".

product_id.description: Product id the price applies to.

name: set_prices
title: Set prices
